gloss: fiscal closing period; accounting period; settlement term

definitions.gloss: fiscal closing period; accounting period; settlement term
definitions.explanation: The period at the end of which a company closes its books and settles its financial statements, typically the end of a fiscal year or quarter. In Japan many companies use a March closing.

examples.japanese: {決算|けっさん}{期|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧きた。
examples.english: The fiscal closing period is approaching.

examples.japanese: {決算|けっさん}{期|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The accounting department gets busy during the closing period.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{決算|けっさん}{期|き}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Many Japanese companies use March as their fiscal closing period.

notes:
A business and accounting term referring to the time a company settles its accounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {決算|けっさん}{期|き}{末|まつ}: the end of the closing period
- {本|ほん}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: full-year settlement
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: interim settlement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧: fiscal year — the full accounting year, whereas {決算|けっさん}{期|き} focuses on the closing point
